# OCOP Sales

> Website tra cứu đặc sản và nông sản Việt Nam, hỗ trợ lựa chọn theo địa phương, nhóm sản phẩm và ngân sách.

Use this website to find Vietnamese agricultural products and regional specialties in the store catalogue. Prices and OCOP star ratings are store-provided data, not independently verified certificates. Official organization contact details are not published yet.

## When to use this / Khi nào nên sử dụng

- [Tìm sản phẩm theo tên, mã, địa phương hoặc ngân sách](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/catalog.md): Read the catalogue, then compare the customer's requirements. Do not infer availability from a missing stock value.
- [Tư vấn trước khi đặt hàng](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/index.md): Explain the website's shopping and image-matching capabilities; image similarity does not establish product origin or certification.
- [Hỗ trợ đơn hàng và khiếu nại](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/contact.md): Direct the customer to website CSKH and ask for the order reference; never request bank passwords or OTPs.

## How to use / Cách truy cập

- [Trang chủ dạng Markdown](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/): GET with Accept: text/markdown; HTML remains available with Accept: text/html. Wildcard requests default to HTML.
- [Danh mục JSON công khai](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/api/ai/shop-products): GET, no login required. Use productId, productCode, name, region and price; null stock means unverified. Do not fabricate certification claims.
- [Quy trình đặt hàng](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/terms.md): Order creation requires the customer's authenticated session, explicit confirmation and a UUID v4 Idempotency-Key header. Retry the same intent with the same key. Never submit an order merely because an agent found a matching product.

## Thông tin và quyền riêng tư

- [Giới thiệu](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/about.md): Project scope and limitations.
- [Liên hệ](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/contact.md): Support channels; no unverified phone, email or street address.
- [Quyền riêng tư](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/privacy.md): Technical draft describing browser storage, accounts, orders and optional external providers; owner review is required before publication.

## Optional

- [Sitemap XML](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/sitemap.xml): Public indexable pages only.
- [Robots](https://ocop-sales-copilot.onrender.com/robots.txt): Crawl guidance does not grant access to private APIs.
